Situation Report — Day 27 (last 6 hrs)

  • Ceasefire pause: Trump announced a second 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET). He says talks are “going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. (First pause was previously violated by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.)
  • Deconfliction: CENTCOM and IRGC representatives are operating in a Doha deconfliction cell. Vance announced an unprecedented CENTCOM–IRGC channel — first formal public military contact of this type.
  • Northern Border (Lebanon): Quds Force commander demands Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. Netanyahu says IDF will stay “as long as required.” Hezbollah activity continues daily; cross‑border fire and strikes remain routine.
  • Strait of Hormuz / Maritime: UN agency paused a Hormuz ship evacuation initiative after a vessel was attacked. Iran warns it won’t guarantee safety outside established routes. Reuters: crude shipments through Hormuz at their highest level since the war began. Iran selectively allows passage for Russia, India and China.
  • Maritime attack: US officials report Iran fired on a cargo ship in recent hours.
  • Military posture: Continued military air traffic observed. IDF chief called for all available male and female combat soldiers. Israeli presidential helicopter made an emergency landing after a bird strike (no combat damage reported).
  • Diplomacy / International moves: Gulf states weighing next steps; Rubio visiting Bahrain/Kuwait/UAE. NATO leaders attempting to manage tensions with US over the campaign.
  • 🟢 Good News: CENTCOM–IRGC deconfliction cell active in Doha — lowers immediate miscalculation risk. Crude flows through Hormuz continue, limiting an immediate oil shock.

Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • גבול צפון (לבנון): מפקד כוח קדס דורש יציאה ישראלית מלבנון. נתניהו מצהיר שהצבא יישאר "כמה שיידרש". פעילות חזבאללה יום-יומית נמשכת; ירי ופעולות חוצות-גבול שגרתיות.
  • מעבר הורמוז/ימי: סוכנות של האו"ם עצרה יוזמת פינוי ספינות בהורמוז אחרי תקיפה של האונייה. איראן מזהירה שלא תבטיח ביטחון מחוץ למסלולים מקובלים. רויטרס: משלוחי נפט דרך הורמוז בשיא מאז פתיחת המלחמה. איראן מאפשרת מעבר בררני לרוסיה, הודו וסין.
  • תקיפה ימית: גורמים אמריקאים מדווחים שאיראן ירתה על ספינת מטען בשעות האחרונות.
  • עמדה צבאית: פעילות אווירית צבאית נמשכת. הרמטכ"ל קורא למילוי יחידות בקרב של גברים ונשים. מסוק נשיאותי נאלץ לנחות חירום בעקבות פגיעה מציפור (ללא נזק לחימה).
  • דיפלומטיה/צעדים בינלאומיים: מדינות המפרץ שוקלות צעדים; רובריו מבקר בבחריין/כווית/איחוד. מנהיגי נאט"ו מנסים לייצב מתחים מול ארה"ב.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: ערוץ התיאום CENTCOM–IRGC בדוחא פעיל — מפחית סיכון טעויות מידיות. זרימת נפט דרך הורמוז נמשכת, מצמצמת זעזוע מידי במחירים.

הערכת איום: בהסלמה.

Situation Report — Day 27 (last 24h)

  • Pause & talks: Trump announced a SECOND 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 20:00 ET). Administration says pause followed an Iranian request; Iran denies direct talks. First pause (Mar 23, 5 days) was violated by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Deconfliction / Mediation: Pakistan is mediating. US CENTCOM and IRGC reps are reported in a Doha deconfliction cell — unprecedented direct military channel on the table.

  • Air & Sea

  • Iran has allowed passage through the Strait of Hormuz for select "friendly" states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others.
  • UN agency paused a Hormuz ship-evacuation initiative after a vessel was attacked. Reuters and other outlets report Iran fired on a cargo ship in the area.
  • Crude shipments through Hormuz are at their highest level since the war began — traffic continues despite risk.

  • Northern Border

  • Hezbollah active daily. Exchange of fire and rocket/missile salvos continue along Lebanese front lines.
  • Quds Force commander publicly demands Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon; Israel says it will remain in Lebanon, Syria, Gaza “as long as required.”

  • Operations & Readiness

  • US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets continue. Iran-backed groups and Iran have launched missile/counterstrike attacks at Israel.
  • IDF chief: military needs “every male and female combat soldier.” Troop readiness and mobilization emphasis ongoing.
  • Syria airports reported closed; sporadic military flights detected in the region.

  • Diplomacy & International

  • Gulf states weighing next steps; some Arab capitals seek compensation for Iran strikes per US lawmakers’ statements.
  • NATO/European leaders remain split; friction with US leadership reported but no major troop redeployments in Europe announced.
  • Germany hosted naval contacts with Israel in Haifa (routine allied engagement).
  • 🟢 Good News: 10-day pause announced and a CENTCOM–IRGC deconfliction channel are active; Pakistan mediation ongoing. Maritime traffic through Hormuz continues.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating
